why_not_fitted: Weather-conditioned regressions on RESIDE-AC lost to plain persistence in 7 of 11 houses and implied envelope time constants of 9 hours to 9.5 days.
RESIDE AC labels were assigned using current AND temperature change, so no cooling coefficient fitted to them is an identified causal effect.
Outdoor forcing available for RESIDE is city-cell reanalysis held hourly, which carries almost no information at a 15-minute step.
Per project rule, a parameter that cannot be established from the sources stays a declared, versioned scenario parameter.

envelope_time_constant_hours.basis: Lumped time constant for a conditioned room. Two independent diagnostics on RESIDE-AC indicated a SLOWER envelope than a conventional 4 h: per-house regressions implied 9 h to 9.5 days, and replaying a 4 h model on observed AC-off intervals over-warmed by 0.15 C per 15 min. RESIDE is used here only to direct and bound this value, never to fit it. 8 h is a declared assumption.

internal_gain_c_per_15min.basis: Lumped occupancy, lighting and appliance gain. No occupancy model is wired in yet.

ac_full_cooling_c_per_15min.basis: Temperature drop over one interval at continuous compressor operation. Sized by the standard convention that a correctly specified unit holds its setpoint at a design outdoor condition: coupling * (design_outdoor_c - design_setpoint_c) + internal gain. At tau 8 h, 39 C outdoor and a 24 C setpoint this is 0.49 C per 15 min; 0.55 adds a small sizing margin. The upper bound stays below the observed RESIDE AC-on first-percentile change of -1.367 C per 15 min, itself a net change not a cooling rate.

default_setpoint_c.basis: Placeholder household setpoint. RESIDE house metadata records homeowner-stated setpoints per house and is the intended future source for this.

comfort_band_c.basis: Comfort band used for discomfort reward and shield masking. A policy choice, not a measurement.
